title: zannichellia palustris subsp. cyclostigma
intro: Zannichellia palustris subsp. cyclostigma, commonly known as hornwort, is a submerged aquatic plant that belongs to the family Zannichelliaceae. The health benefits of Zannichellia palustris subsp. cyclostigma include its potential to reduce inflammation, improve wound healing, and exhibit antibacterial properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and glycosides, that may exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial actions. However, more research is needed to fully understand the bioactive constituents of this plant, and its therapeutic potential is still being studied.
